author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Rate curve fixture (Story 2.6): 120 s. Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a theta rate that cycles over 2 to 6 Hz every 60 s (center 4 Hz, swing 2 Hz, start phase 0 degrees), 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz, its AM depth opening to 100 percent for bursts centered on the 0 degree coupling phase of the curved theta reference (50 ms with 10 ms raised-cosine edges at the 4 Hz center, fixed shares of the theta cycle), 0 between bursts. Both the same in both channels; together they can peak near 2.0, so the 24-bit WAV can clip. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
